value.rationale: The complete spectrum and sharp Fourier projection endpoint norm are canonical invariants of the finite-field decomposable-tensor cone, with spectral relevance to tensor-rank Cayley graphs and explicit amplification q^2-q+1+O(q^-1). Identifying exactly one field order with 108 Fourier zeros gives a qualitative support boundary not provided by general pointwise character formulas alone. The all-field evaluation requires a geometric census and absolute-sign summation, rather than a mere parameter renaming.
